## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Measurement impact

- [ ] No benchmark estimand, denominator, system boundary, or ranking rule changes.
- [ ] Protocol or schema change is documented and versioned.
- [ ] Historical comparability impact is explained.
- [ ] Conflicts, provider affiliations, funding, and API credits are disclosed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Reference protocol audit passes.
- [ ] Generated artifacts were rebuilt from frozen inputs.
- [ ] Updated PDFs were rendered and visually inspected.
- [ ] No credentials, private items, personal data, or sensitive traces are included.

## Evidence

List commands, artifact identifiers, hashes, and any deviations.
